name: findcheap-agent
description: Search products from text or visual evidence, compare verified offers, find deals, and monitor prices, promotions, and stock.

interface.shortDescription: Verified cards, pricing, coupons, and safe links.
interface.longDescription: FindCheap Agent is a Codex Plugin Agent. v0.16.6 keeps evidence-first search, three-tier card display, stable selected-product identity, and read-only safety boundaries. High-confidence suspected product names from interactive image analysis now receive an exact official-store retrieval pass before descriptive visual fallback, without becoming identity proof. Product size, intended use, and budget rank valid candidates without corrupting exact product-family identity. Broad laptops, phones, cameras, and displays request missing decision constraints before merchant search. Backend recommendation logic selects one stable primarySelectionId only when product fit and merchant evidence support a purchase recommendation; otherwise cards remain research-only. Official-site display order no longer forces the primary choice, and equally suitable trusted products prefer the lower item price. English and Chinese requests use the same structured decision with localized wording. Product-card interface language follows the user's current request independently from catalog query translation. Full-size and large-package requests exclude samples, trial packs, trial sizes, and testers before ranking. Checkout remains the authority for eligibility, stacking, shipping, tax, and final totals. Reviewed Awin merchants remain eligible for trusted exact-and-similar matches, while qualifying Shopify results are labeled as high-rated Shopify merchants. Commission never changes product relevance scoring. Railway serves reviewed official storefronts and trusted merchants from schema-valid immutable releases; invalid or unavailable database snapshots cannot replace the last valid registry. Official cards require an approved exact domain, verified product identity, a valid public USD price, and stable product identity. Unsupported sites may use user-authorized Chrome only as a bounded fallback. Product family and explicit brand/model stay hard; uncertain visual details remain soft clues and never create EXACT identity. The agent never invents identity, discount eligibility, stacking, merchant authorization, or delivered totals; it never checks out, reserves inventory, purchases, or pays.
defaultPrompt: User language only. EN: "Searching for suitable products." ZH: "正在搜索合适商品。" Then tool. No plan/Memory/repo.
